svg.title: Praise for YJIT from production users
svg.desc: Posts from DHH, Nony Dutton at Zendesk and Renaud Chaput of mastodon.social reporting 15 to 24 percent speedups after enabling YJIT in production, with more posts stacked behind them.

g.text: All storefront requests are now served by the latest version
of ruby with YJIT enabled! We are seeing ~10% speedups.
YJIT was enabled on rubygems.org today and our #rails P95
average latency improved by an eye watering 20%!!!
We turned on yjit in production

svg.text: YJIT is juicy! We're seeing +24% faster on the median, +12% on
the average, and +10% on the P90 with Ruby 3.3 using YJIT in
production on @basecamp. Major kudos to the fine folks at
I enabled YJIT on half of the production pods for one of
our largest services at Zendesk. [...] we've seen a ~20%
performance improvement to our median request duration [...]
We deployed Ruby 3.3.1 +YJIT to mastodon.social today, and it
looks like we see a ~15% improvement in HTTP response times.
[...] CPU usage might be slightly lower as well.
